notes.title: Release Date & New Trailer
notes.notes:
Cheerleaders, it's time to assemble!



We have a very good news for you: our colorful, joyful, and b*das* beat'em up Ra Ra BOOM will be released in a little bit more than a month! Save the date, you will be able to enjoy the full game on August 12. 



Check the new trailer, hit the training ground, get to know your sheroes, and get ready for this brand new adventure! 


[previewyoutube="dKOXf0Ye5Ig;full"][/previewyoutube]
In  the meantime, play the demo, ask us anything and follow us on social to not miss any announcement!



Cheers !
